title: T3 Persist Models and Compare columns independently
description: Implement URL-first, page-isolated browser persistence for column selection, including an explicit empty selection.
action: Define precedence as explicit URL cols > the current page storage key > page defaults. Use llm-info:models:columns:v1 only on Models and llm-info:compare:columns:v1 only on Compare. parseVisibleColumns('none') returns [], serializeColumns([]) returns 'none', default selection retains empty canonical serialization, and wholly unknown input falls back to defaults.
implementation: Make ColumnPicker the only client persistence boundary with storageKey and explicit-URL-state props; validate stored values through the shared parser and canonicalize with router.replace only when URL cols is absent and stored selection differs from defaults.
Treat presence of cols as explicit even for cols=none or cols=; on apply persist ordered selection and navigate with cols, retaining page state but omitting page.
On reset-columns clear only the current storage key and cols, retain all page filters and sort including Compare sort=none, and leave the sibling key unchanged.
After implementation, add parser/serializer unit cases plus E2E precedence, refresh, away/back, empty, isolation, reset, hydration, keyboard, and axe evidence.
convergence_criteria: parseVisibleColumns('none', registry) returns [] and serializeColumns([], registry) returns 'none'.
[UI-observable] Explicit URL cols wins over conflicting storage; absent URL uses only the page-specific key; absent URL and storage uses page defaults.
Empty selection survives apply, refresh, and navigation away/back on both pages.
Reset columns clears only the current page key and cols while preserving filters/sort and the other page key.
Hydrated picker keyboard flow completes with 0 serious or critical axe violations.
verify: npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/catalog.spec.ts --grep "column persistence|reset columns"
